action.newText: Migration `20261210110000_refresh_token_client` adds two nullable columns to `RefreshToken`: `usedUaHash String?` (lowercase sha256 hex of the User-Agent header; when the header is absent, store the sha256 hex of the empty string, never a literal empty string) and `usedIp String?` (the client IP as Fastify resolves it through the trusted proxies configured in `main.ts`).

rationale: This resolves inconsistent specification wording without changing the intended recovery behavior. Existing pre-migration rows remain null and fail closed on lost-response recovery.
